name: Intersection of Silver St. & Brass St.
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. There are quite a few people here, most of them
desc3: streaming from Brass street westwards, towards the town square. Even
desc4: so, it is quiet, as the townspeople go about their business in
desc5: silence.  Brass street starts here and continues to the north, and
desc6: Silver street continues to the east and west.
